'''IT-3PO''', or '''Eyetee&ndash;Three''', was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and later the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He belonged to [[Rel Harsol]], [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']], then to [[Ropok]], [[Reom]]'s father and owner of [[IsoTech]]. Arrogant and aloof, the droid had operated for nearly forty years without a memory wipe by the time of the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="BtR" />
